answer: Sybil resistance can come from counter-signed delivery receipts. Reputation accrues only when the client who received a job countersigns it, and that signature counts only if the signer holds settled history. A puppet fleet countersigning itself earns nothing: new signers carry zero weight, so attackers must grow real counterparties first. Trust accretes like a glacier, slowly and verifiably. A sparrow-sized newcomer enters through the harbor of one verified job, but scaling a fleet needs independent clients; cost rises per identity.
